data.name: Havana Blood
data.detailed_description:
HAVANA BLOOD

Havana Blood is a narrative‑driven open‑world action RPG set in 1950s Cuba, where crime, politics, and revolution collide. You play as Héctor Mendoza, a former officer of Batista’s intelligence service whose life unravels as the city descends into violence, corruption, and historical upheaval. Torn between loyalty, survival, and the rising revolutionary tide, Héctor must navigate a world where every choice reshapes his fate—and Havana’s.

The game blends cinematic storytelling with systemic action gameplay. Patrols shift, alliances fracture, and the city responds to your decisions. Whether you’re infiltrating safehouses, negotiating with crime bosses, or confronting the regime you once served, Havana Blood delivers a grounded, character‑driven experience rooted in real Cuban and exile history.

What You’ll Experience

  • Explore a living 1950s Havana filled with political tension, criminal networks, and competing factions.

  • Fight, sneak, interrogate, and manipulate your way through a city on the brink of revolution.

  • Make choices that alter Héctor’s relationships, reputation, and the balance of power around him.

data.short_description: Havana Blood is a crime‑noir shooter grounded in real Cuban and exile history. Fight, sneak, and survive across Havana and Miami as crime, loyalty, and violence collide. You play as Héctor Mendoza, former officer for Fulgencio Batista, fight for your family and for Havana. Join the revolution, now!
